block_1_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
block_1_metadata.role: Master Engine Settings Registry orchestrating active settings profiles across display, audio, input, performance, and diagnostics.
what_it_enables: Unified single-point dispatch for in-game Options UI and user configuration
Decoupled resolution, framerate, and theme selection via viewport settings
Hardware-independent volume levels, mute flags, and audio device preferences
Configurable keyboard action bindings and gamepad deadzone profiles
Performance pacing policy selection between 30, 60, and 120 FPS targets
Zero dynamic heap allocations during settings ingestion (ALLOC_ZERO_HEAP)
invariants: Zero dynamic heap allocations across settings ingestion (ALLOC_ZERO_HEAP)
All linked settings profiles must exist and satisfy 5-block envelope
Procedural fallback floor guaranteed regardless of user settings

pre_conditions.memory_model: Static fixed buffers without heap allocation

viewport.title: Display & Viewport Presentation
viewport.description: Active display resolution preset, window mode, V-Sync, theme, and UI scaling.

audio.title: Audio Mixer & Volume Channels
audio.description: Master, BGM, SFX, Ambience, and UI volume percentages, mute toggles, and ducking.

input.title: Input Bindings & Control Profiles
input.description: Primary and secondary action keybindings, repeat rates, and controller mappings.

performance.title: Frame Pacing & Simulation Budget
performance.description: Target frame rate (60 FPS standard), frame time budget, and accumulator parameters.

diagnostics.title: Telemetry & Log Severity Filter
diagnostics.description: Active diagnostic telemetry profile, severity bitmask, and ring buffer threshold.

verification_tripwires.name: PROFILE_EXISTENCE
verification_tripwires.rule: All referenced active profiles must exist on disk

verification_tripwires.name: ALLOC_ZERO_HEAP
verification_tripwires.rule: Settings parsing must perform zero heap allocations
